content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A green farewell in the lungs of the city, with lakes, squirrels, and a castle on the hill."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Murals and marble, a quick hit of golden-age glamour before the evening kicks in."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The heart of the old city, all stone, flag and slow-fading afternoon light."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Vegan tacos that even a carnivore would chase across town for."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Masked heroes, flying bodies and a crowd that roars like it means it."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"meal","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Al pastor carved straight off the trompo, with a salsa bar that rewards a second lap."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A market where the fruit stalls look like a paintbox and the chatter never stops."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Bright, breezy plates that make a long lunch feel like the whole point of the day."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A castle with a view that makes the city look like it is showing off."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A slow float on the canals, with mariachi drifting over the water like weather."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Seafood tostadas that taste like the coast sent a postcard."}]}
Centro after dark, Coyoacán and the canals, then a Chapultepec goodbye — every must-do tucked in, nice and neat.
